prompts.prompt: On a very dark November morning, two lovers wake beside each other in bed, their hands still holding together. One has already spent two hours awake, unable to return to sleep because thoughts of work keep troubling the mind; the other has just emerged from an unusually vivid dream about a childhood friend. Outside, the morning remains cold and almost lightless, while the warmth of their shared bed slowly gives way to the ordinary necessities of departure. One prepares tea in the kitchen, listening to the familiar sound of the other taking a shower in the bathroom. They know that life will keep them apart for a long while, and neither can make the morning last. Their tenderness remains in small gestures, familiar sounds, and the quiet knowledge of having been together.
